description: This file defines internal architecture-specific kernel APIs for the Zephyr RTOS, including thread management, power management, memory mapping, and core dump handling.

methods.name: arch_new_thread
methods.description: Sets up architecture-specific thread context and stack for a new thread.

methods.name: arch_switch
methods.description: Performs a context switch between threads, implementation varies by architecture.

methods.name: arch_swap
methods.description: Performs a cooperative context switch, older method, requires interrupt lock.

methods.name: arch_thread_return_value_set
methods.description: Sets the return value for a thread, used during context switching.

methods.name: arch_switch_to_main_thread
methods.description: Early boot function to switch to main thread context.

methods.name: arch_float_disable
methods.description: Disables floating point context preservation for a thread.

methods.name: arch_float_enable
methods.description: Enables floating point context preservation for a thread.

methods.name: arch_system_halt
methods.description: Halts the system with an optional reason code.

methods.name: arch_is_in_isr
methods.description: Checks if the current context is in an interrupt service routine.

methods.name: arch_mem_map
methods.description: Maps physical memory into virtual address space.

methods.name: arch_mem_unmap
methods.description: Removes virtual memory mappings.

methods.name: arch_page_phys_get
methods.description: Retrieves physical address mapped to a virtual address.

methods.name: arch_reserved_pages_update
methods.description: Marks reserved pages in system RAM.

methods.name: arch_mem_page_out
methods.description: Marks a data page as paged out.

methods.name: arch_mem_page_in
methods.description: Marks a data page as paged in.

methods.name: arch_mem_scratch
methods.description: Creates a temporary mapping to a physical page.

methods.name: arch_page_location_get
methods.description: Gets the location status of a page.

methods.name: arch_page_info_get
methods.description: Retrieves characteristics and states of a page.

methods.name: arch_coredump_info_dump
methods.description: Handles architecture-specific core dump information.

methods.name: arch_coredump_tgt_code_get
methods.description: Returns target code for core dump.

methods.name: arch_tls_stack_setup
methods.description: Sets up thread-local storage area in stack.

methods.name: arch_printk_char_out
methods.description: Outputs a character during early boot for debugging.

methods.name: arch_kernel_init
methods.description: Architecture-specific kernel initialization hook.

methods.name: arch_nop
methods.description: No-operation function.
